subject: design/implement-now-e2e-tasks
statement: the document is read at the **plan's freeze revision**, and the resolved content's fingerprint is recorded in the origin-decision event. The plan freezes at merge, so its recorded reference resolves to exactly one revision of the referenced document; reading there satisfies the data contract's integrity rule without the executor ever depending on the working tree's current state, and the recorded fingerprint makes *which bytes a worker was briefed from* an auditable fact rather than an assumption.
